title: The Shark That Bites Perfect Circles Out Of You

<svg viewBox='0 0 200 150' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><ellipse cx='100' cy='75' rx='70' ry='50' fill='#0b1a22'/><ellipse cx='100' cy='75' rx='86' ry='64' fill='none' stroke='#f3f6f7' stroke-width='8'/></svg>

scenes.notes: This tiny shark bites perfect circles out of you.
Forget great whites. Forget tiger sharks. Forget every movie shark you grew up scared of.
The one whales fear is the cookiecutter, half a metre long. Next to a blue whale, that's a pencil on a bus.

layers.markup: <svg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='100' cy='100' r='88' fill='none' stroke='#f3f6f7' stroke-width='8'/></svg>

scenes.notes: By day it hides a kilometre below you. At night it rises, belly glowing green, except a dark collar that looks like a small fish. That's the bait.

layers.markup: <svg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='88' y='20' width='24' height='90' rx='8' fill='#f3f6f7'/><path d='M30 180 Q100 70 170 180 Z' fill='#cfd6d9'/></svg>

<svg viewBox='0 0 200 220' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><g fill='none' stroke='#f3f6f7' stroke-width='12'><circle cx='100' cy='30' r='18'/><path d='M100 48 L100 196 M60 76 L140 76 M30 140 Q40 200 100 200 Q160 200 170 140'/></g></svg>

scenes.notes: Bite the fish, and you meet three tools: lips that seal like a suction cup, top teeth that hook in like anchors,
and a row of triangle teeth locked into one saw. Then it spins its whole body like a hole saw,

layers.markup: <svg viewBox='0 0 1000 420' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='0' y='100' width='1000' height='320' fill='#e8dccb'/><rect x='0' y='60' width='1000' height='40' fill='#7d8a90'/><rect x='430' y='60' width='140' height='220' rx='20' fill='#0b1a22'/></svg>
<svg viewBox='0 0 140 220' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><path d='M0 0 L140 0 L140 200 Q70 230 0 200 Z' fill='#e8dccb'/><rect x='0' y='0' width='140' height='40' fill='#7d8a90'/></svg>

scenes.notes: and rips free with a plug of whale five centimetres wide. An ice-cream scoop, and the whale keeps swimming.
A whale can spare a scoop. You have less to spare. You're swimming at night, far from land, when something cold presses flat on your skin.

layers.markup: <svg viewBox='0 0 1200 600' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><path d='M0 150 Q600 30 1200 150 L1200 600 L0 600 Z' fill='#cdbfb6'/><path d='M0 300 Q600 190 1200 300 M0 440 Q600 330 1200 440' stroke='#b9aba2' stroke-width='8' fill='none'/></svg>
<svg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='100' cy='100' r='96' fill='#0b1a22'/></svg>
<svg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='100' cy='100' r='88' fill='none' stroke='#f3f6f7' stroke-width='8'/></svg>

scenes.notes: The hooks grip, the saw closes, it spins, and a round piece of you is gone.
Not a what-if. In two thousand nine, a night swimmer off Hawaii became the first living person it's known to have bitten.

layers.markup: <svg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='100' cy='100' r='84' fill='none' stroke='#e5483d' stroke-width='22'/></svg>

scenes.notes: He survived. The round wound gave the shark away.
When its saw wears down, it swallows the whole row of teeth and keeps going: dolphins, tuna, great whites, even the rubber noses of navy submarines.

<svg viewBox='0 0 200 150' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><ellipse cx='100' cy='75' rx='70' ry='50' fill='#0b1a22'/><ellipse cx='100' cy='75' rx='86' ry='64' fill='none' stroke='#f3f6f7' stroke-width='8'/></svg>

scenes.notes: And tonight, somewhere in the dark, a whale is getting one more circle.
